description: Put items into categories, a brand and an item group (up to 200 items per call, by id or SKU). categoryIds replaces each item's categories (an empty list clears them); addCategoryIds / removeCategoryIds adjust them instead. brandId / groupId set the brand and group (clearBrand / clearGroup remove them); omitted parts keep each item's current value. Ids come from list_catalog_taxonomy. The preview shows each item's before→after and skips items already classified that way. A change that moves an item into or out of a discount's categories or brand updates its discounted price, as the item form does. A client-pinned credential classifies only its own items.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

input.description: The items and the classification to apply.

addCategoryIds.description: Category ids to add to each item, keeping its others.

brandId.description: Brand id (GUID) to set on each item. Omit to keep each item's brand.

categoryIds.description: Replace each item's categories with exactly these category ids (an empty list clears them). Cannot be combined with addCategoryIds/removeCategoryIds.

groupId.description: Item group id (GUID) to set on each item. Omit to keep each item's group.

items.description: Item ids (GUIDs) or SKUs to classify (max 200). Every one must resolve.

removeCategoryIds.description: Category ids to remove from each item.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.
